tailoring.headline: Senior Java & SAP Commerce Cloud Engineer – E-Commerce & PIM Integration
tailoring.summary: Backend specialist with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in designing PIM-ERP-MDM data flows, API integrations, large-scale migrations and platform upgrades. Strong techno-functional consulting experience, translating business requirements into robust data models and micro-service APIs. Proven record in production support, CI/CD and agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Pimcore Engineer - PIM/MAM (d/f/m)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Ottobock’s PiX platform that unifies product information and media assets, a challenge that aligns perfectly with my five-plus years designing and operating large-scale e-commerce data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Requirement Analysis
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I analysed complex product-catalog requirements, designed data models and mapped data flows between PIM, ERP and MDM, ensuring seamless integration for global storefronts.

bullets.label: Technical Coordination
bullets.text: I led coordination with international development teams, reviewed custom OCC services and data-pipeline code, guaranteeing quality and maintainability across multi-vendor environments.

bullets.label: Data Model Implementation
bullets.text: I built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris import pipelines using DataHub and Hotfolders, extending data objects and export routines to keep product catalogs synchronized.

bullets.label: Issue Resolution & Migration
bullets.text: I diagnosed integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, executed API migrations and supported platform upgrades, reducing downtime and improving data consistency.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holding a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to PiX.

tailoring.why_company: Ottobock’s mission to improve mobility through innovative products resonates with my passion for delivering reliable digital experiences. PiX’s centralised product-information hub built on Pimcore offers a unique opportunity to apply my expertise in PIM-ERP-MDM integrations and data-model design, helping Ottobock scale its content delivery across global channels while maintaining data quality.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to help Ottobock scale PiX’s product-information platform, leveraging my proven PIM-ERP integration and e-commerce expertise to deliver robust, future-ready solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Ivana, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud engineer with 5+ years of PIM/ERP integration experience. I’m eager to bring my expertise to Ottobock’s PiX platform. Could we discuss how I can add value?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will streamline PiX’s data-model extensions, apply my experience with large-scale PIM-ERP migrations and enhance API integrations, drawing on proven SAP Commerce Cloud upgrades and OCC/Spartacus implementations. My background in production support ensures rapid issue resolution and stable releases.
tailoring.insight: The posting highlights PiX as a central hub feeding data to websites and e-commerce apps; my track record of building robust PIM-to-e-commerce pipelines positions me to accelerate PiX’s integration reliability and scalability.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Pimcore Engineer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with extensive PIM/ERP integration experience. Ottobock’s PiX platform’s focus on unified product data aligns with my background in building scalable data pipelines and supporting platform upgrades. I can immediately contribute to enhancing PiX’s data model and integration reliability. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
